a: Master's up to $40,000; doctoral up to $100,000; postdoc up to $35,000 (1 yr); short-term research up to $12,000 (4 months)
dt: Dec 2, 2026, 4:00 pm ET; candidates must first be pre-selected/nominated by a Québec university (internal deadlines earlier)
e: For non-Canadians only (no citizenship or PR), who must be nominated by a Québec university. Lets US/international students or postdocs fund work at Québec radio/pulsar groups (e.g. McGill).
n: FRQ PBEEE (Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students)
